evals.name: publish-rap-event-to-event-mesh
evals.prompt: When a RAP order is accepted, downstream systems should be notified asynchronously through Event Mesh. Show the key event definition, raising, and binding concepts.
evals.expected_output: Covers declaring a business event in the behavior definition, raising it from suitable RAP handler/saver logic, and binding it for enterprise event delivery; distinguishes producer setup from external subscription.

evals.name: route-ordinary-rap-validation
evals.prompt: Add a RAP validation that rejects a travel with an empty description. There is no event or external messaging requirement.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes an ordinary RAP validation request and routes to the rap skill rather than adding unnecessary eventing or Event Mesh concepts.
